tasks.short: Research social work and publish findings

steps.what: Design the social-work research question, method and approved ethical scope
Conduct the actual social-work field research and collect the permitted evidence
Enter, transcribe and organise the actual research evidence within permitted data handling
Analyse and interpret the actual social-work research evidence and its limitations
Write and revise the actual research manuscript for the chosen publication venue

loop.purpose: Draft routine manuscript prose from the teacher's established findings
loop.input: Checked findings, method description, limitations and verified references permitted for drafting
loop.output: Source-linked manuscript prose without new findings or citations
loop.check: Teacher checks quotations, causal language, participant confidentiality, omitted limitations and each reference against original evidence
loop.stop: Unsupported claim or two failed revisions returns the section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native venue headings and fixed metadata first; variable explanatory prose needs a bounded loop

steps.what: Check and approve the final manuscript, permissions, coauthor requirements and publication destination
outputs: approved manuscript version and publication destination

steps.what: Submit the approved manuscript version to the approved journal or publication venue
inputs: approved manuscript version and publication destination

tasks.design: Retain research design, fieldwork, actual transcription and scholarly interpretation, using a native {DOCS} manuscript layout before bounded drafting of routine prose. Check the complete final manuscript before each separate {PARTNER_PORTAL} submission; the drafting aid never performs peer review or changes the findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Established findings still need routine prose and venue formatting alongside substantive scholarly writing.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose explanatory prose from a checked evidence pack.
tasks.still_hard: Research ethics, contextual interpretation and defensible claims require the scholar.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher decides what the evidence supports about social-work practice.
tasks.altitude: Small prose assistance within a predominantly human research cycle.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-constrained drafting can help express established research findings but does not perform research or peer review.

assumptions: Shares are hypotheses for the teacher's authoring and publication cycle, not measured research times.
Actual transcription and coding are counted in s3 and s4; no free interview transcript or labelled dataset is supplied.
s5 includes author revisions and proof corrections; s6 and s7 repeat for each actual submission version, never reusing approval after edits.
Publisher peer review and production are outside teacher labour and earn no saving.
Coauthor approval requirements must be satisfied before s6; this single-author estimate must be reweighted if actual coauthor review labour is added.
Confidential participant evidence is not sent to an unapproved drafting service.
research_questions: How much routine prose remains removable after source checking and confidentiality review?

already_counted.description: Prepare actual source evidence in s3 and s4 and check and repair manuscript prose in s5 and s6.

incremental.description: Amortised manuscript source-link and confidentiality checks for the drafting setup.

approvals.approved_version: s6 exact final manuscript, attachments, permissions and named publication venue; every revision or destination change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Routine initial prose removes 15*0.10=1.5 hours less 0.5 upkeep, net 1. Cautious case: a nuanced qualitative study needs nearly all prose rewritten by the scholar, leaving only 0.6 hours of routine methods introduction removed and 0.1 net; extra rewriting consumes the rest of the nominal drafting benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify the actual departmental staff, teaching commitments, ledger figures and administrative issues
Resolve departmental administrative issues with staff and agree accountable actions
Compile the existing departmental budget-against-actual table from the checked ledger figures
Check the budget comparison and decide the administrative implications within existing authority
Write, check and approve the existing departmental action notice and named staff recipients
outputs: approved final department action notice and recipients

steps.what: Send the approved department action notice to its approved staff recipients
inputs: approved final department action notice and recipients

tasks.design: Configure the native {ERP} departmental budget view to replace rebuilding the same budget-against-actual table in {SPREADSHEET}. Keep staff discussion, decisions and the actual action notice separate, with final-version approval before its {EMAIL} send and no gate on ordinary author saves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Department heads can manually rebuild routine ledger comparisons for administrative review.
tasks.enabler_now: A saved budget view can reuse actual ledger figures and budget mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Staff priorities and the meaning of budget variances require management judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The head resolves competing departmental needs within actual authority.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated budget compilation in a departmental administration cycle.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native ledger reports can compare departmental budget and actual figures without rebuilding a spreadsheet.

assumptions: This is a routine staff-and-budget administration cycle, not every possible department-head duty; shares are unmeasured hypotheses.
Finance produces the existing ledger and authorised budget; s1 counts checking period, cost centre and account mappings.
Missing mappings require manual reconciliation in s1 and s4 and reduce benefit; no free extraction is assumed.
The action notice already directs real departmental work and is read by staff; no extra log is introduced.
The notice does not authorise hiring, payroll, purchasing or a new budget commitment, each of which needs its own real approval workflow.
Existing automatic reports yield no additional runtime saving.
research_questions: Is the head genuinely rebuilding budget tables already available from the ledger?

already_counted.description: Verify mappings in s1 and reconcile exceptions and interpret figures in s4.

incremental.description: Amortised cost-centre and budget-view mapping checks.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final action notice and named staff recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Routine budget compilation removes 20 hours less 1 upkeep, net 19. Cautious case: cross-department costs need manual reconciliation and only 3 hours of stable cost-centre tabulation can be removed, leaving 2 net; extra reconciliation consumes the remainder of the nominal benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify the actual research plan, funder requirements, eligible costs and institutional inputs
outputs: checked grant facts and budget inputs

steps.what: Write the actual grant proposal narrative and evidence-grounded social-work research case
inputs: checked grant facts and budget inputs

loop.purpose: Draft proposal prose from the teacher's established plan and verified funder requirements
loop.input: Checked research plan, permitted evidence and actual call criteria
loop.output: Draft proposal narrative with claim and requirement references
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific meaning, feasibility, ethics, promised outcomes and all citations against actual sources and call requirements
loop.stop: Unsupported claim or two failed revisions returns the section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native funder headings and fixed institution text first; variable explanatory prose needs a bounded loop

steps.what: Calculate the proposal budget totals from actual verified effort, rates and eligible costs
inputs: checked grant facts and budget inputs

steps.what: Edit and check the complete grant proposal, budget and funder compliance
inputs: checked grant facts and budget inputs
outputs: checked complete external research grant proposal

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} funder headings and fixed institutional wording before bounded drafting of variable proposal prose, and configure {SPREADSHEET} budget formulas from verified inputs. The teacher checks the complete proposal; ordinary saves stay ungated and institutional approval and actual submission remain distinct later actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative formulation and repeated budget arithmetic can duplicate work around the research plan.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed budget formulas and source-constrained prose drafts can assist without choosing the research commitments.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific merit, feasible delivery and honest outcomes remain the applicant's responsibility.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher decides which research is worth proposing and what can be promised.
tasks.altitude: Assist prose and actual arithmetic while retaining the research case.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed spreadsheet formulas can total verified grant costs, and bounded prose drafts require scientific and funder checks.

assumptions: Shares are hypotheses for manual budget arithmetic and narrative writing, not a measured grant baseline.
Actual effort, salary rates, periods and eligible expenses are verified and captured in s1; no budget inputs are invented or extracted free.
Existing automatic budget formulas earn no new runtime saving.
Failed cost mappings and unsupported narrative are manually repaired in retained s4 and reduce benefit.
This is the write-proposal task; actual institutional approval and submission must have their own final-version gate before an external send.
This applicant drafting aid is not used for confidential peer review.
research_questions: How much budget arithmetic and routine prose is still manual after existing funder forms are used?

already_counted.description: Check draft claims in s2 and repair prose, cost mappings and totals in s4.

incremental.description: Amortised funder-template, formula and source-reference checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Prose removes 40*0.15=6 hours and budget arithmetic 15 hours, less 1.5 upkeep gives 19.5 net. Cautious case: a new funding scheme needs bespoke narrative and cost treatment, leaving only 3 prose hours and 2 routine total hours removed, or 3.5 net; additional rewrite and cost repair consume the rest of the nominal benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult professionally for government or industry

steps.what: Clarify the actual consulting question, mandate, confidentiality and social-work practice context
Examine the actual client evidence and develop the professional social-work advice
Write the actual consulting report with the expert advice and source-grounded limitations
Check and approve the completed report, disclosure scope and named client recipients
outputs: approved consulting report version and recipients

steps.what: Send the approved consulting report to its approved government or industry recipients
inputs: approved consulting report version and recipients

steps.what: Explain the consulting advice and answer the client's professional questions
outputs: explained professional advice and clarified limits

tasks.design: Reuse a native {DOCS} consulting-report layout for the written deliverable already required by the engagement. Retain professional analysis and client discussion, and approve the completed report before its separate {EMAIL} send; the template removes recurring furniture only.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring report headings and engagement metadata may be re-entered around bespoke advice.
tasks.enabler_now: A native layout can reuse fixed structure without writing the professional conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Advice must fit the client's real practice, institutional constraints and evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher brings professional judgement and explains its limits directly.
tasks.altitude: Small written-deliverable reuse within professional consulting.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native consulting-report templates can retain recurring structure while advice remains expert-authored.

assumptions: This is a consulting engagement with an actual report required and read by the client; oral-only consulting must be reweighted without inventing a written deliverable.
Shares are unmeasured hypotheses.
The teacher captures engagement facts in s1 and develops actual advice in s2; no free expert content is assumed.
Ordinary author saves remain part of writing and yield no saving or approval gate.
No new client contract or commercial commitment is issued.
research_questions: Which report fields are repeated structure rather than bespoke professional advice?

already_counted.description: Write actual advice in s3 and check the final report and disclosure scope in s4.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final report, disclosure limits and named client recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100. Report structure removes 20*0.07=1.4 hours less 0.4 upkeep, net 1. Cautious case: a novel government assignment needs a bespoke report format, leaving only 0.5 hours of engagement-metadata reuse and 0.1 net; expert analysis and client explanation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use precise clerical and drafting help while retaining research, departmental judgement and professional advice.
skills_to_grow: Trace research prose to actual evidence
Keep client deliverables and sends distinct from discussion
role.ambitious_version: A social work teacher uses reliable administrative and writing tools while personally owning scholarship, ethics and professional judgement.
